RESEARCH / CONSTRUCTION PROTOTYPE 02

Rules create
architecture.

Sculpted envelopes, layered glazing and engineered service regions. Every part is generated in Aether.

Surface / rendering quality

Stable panel UVs in metres. Procedural albedo, normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and packed height. Reveal depth is geometry; height relief is parallax shading.

What this bench proves

Window apertures are open wall rings with chamfers, depth, gaskets and inset glazing. Shared wing walls are removed before meshing. Massing and facade seeds vary independently.

Eight sculpted envelopes use surface-following openings and trim. Facade layers combine bays and floors into glazing, armor, service spines and mechanical zones. City-wide integration, interiors and final art direction remain subsequent work.
